FN-CH5SJWW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 113
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Commissions
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 113 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Manufactured
Housing Commission until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
